# Polygon Gaming (PGT)

> Polygon Gaming (https://polygongaming.io/) is the premier Web3 Play-to-Earn gaming ecosystem built on the Polygon blockchain network. Features include 60 FPS retro arcade games, PolySpace planetary space mining, hourly PGT faucets, high-yield staking vaults, and a 4-tier referral program.

## Core Features & Architecture

- **Token Name**: Polygon Gaming Token (PGT)
- **Token Contract Address (Polygon Mainnet)**: `0x701100D19b1a93672cfe7291EA455b4220631209`
- **Total Supply**: 1,000,000,000 PGT (1 Billion)
- **Ecosystem Network**: Polygon (Chain ID: 137)
- **Play-to-Earn Arcade Games**: Astro-Dodge, Cyber Invaders, Cyber Drift, Cyber-Roshambo, Lucky Spinner, Neon Plinko, Cyber-Crash.
- **PolySpace Mining Expedition**: Planetary starship fleet mining for PGT, Iron, Titanium, and Quantum Crystals.
- **Daily Faucet**: Earn free PGT hourly with optional VIP Supporter Subscription (+100% 2x multiplier, 10% faster 21.6h cooldown).
- **Staking Vaults**: Lock PGT for high APY yield rewards.
- **Referral Program**: 4-tier downline structure (L1: 10%, L2: 5%, L3: 2%, L4: 1%, doubled with VIP).
